module_expected_types.GRWTSK.NumberTheory.AdditiveNumberTheory:
∀ (A X Y : Finset Nat) (hpos : ∀ a ∈ A, 0 < a)
  (hX : X ⊆ A) (hY : Y ⊆ A) (hne : X ≠ Y)
  (heq : Finset.sum X id = Finset.sum Y id),
  ∃ S T : Finset Nat, S ⊆ A ∧ T ⊆ A ∧ Disjoint S T ∧
    S.Nonempty ∧ T.Nonempty ∧ 0 < Finset.sum S id ∧
    Finset.sum S id = Finset.sum T id

∀ (A : Finset Nat)
  (hmass : (2 : Real) ≤ Finset.sum A (fun a : Nat => (1 : Real) / (a : Real))),
  ∃ S T : Finset Nat, S ⊆ Finset.erase A 0 ∧ T ⊆ Finset.erase A 0 ∧ Disjoint S T ∧
    S.Nonempty ∧ T.Nonempty ∧ 0 < Finset.sum S id ∧
    Finset.sum S id = Finset.sum T id
